info.name: Mobile Activation Service (TMF622)
info.description:
End-to-end tests for the TMF622 mobile activation API with stubbed billing, charging, CRM and Kafka.

Run against a local instance (`mvn spring-boot:run`, stubs enabled). Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner or `newman run`.

request.description: Clears recorded stub invocations and Kafka events so the next scenario starts clean.

exec: // Fulfillment starts asynchronously, so the response may already show inProgress.
pm.test("Location header points to the order", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.include(body.id));
// Fulfillment is asynchronous; give the Camel route time to finish (incl. retries).
